survivors.title: Bellows Bench
survivors.pitch: The phone becomes the tool — the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page for jewelry workshops: piece tracking minutes after the work happens, auto-makes a 30-second recap the owner will repost.

verdicts.attack: SOPs for training are well-trodden territory, not frontier
verdicts.why: Generic training solution with incremental value

verdicts.attack: Voice transcription might struggle with workshop noise
verdicts.why: Creative, ambitious, and solves a real problem with a novel approach
